name: ideal-client-profile
description: Type @Ideal Client Persona to simulate an approved buyer profile from the active client's Airtable Ideal Client Profiles table.

interface.longDescription: Choose any approved named ideal-client or referral partner profile from this engagement's Airtable records, then receive independent, realistic first-person buyer reactions. No personas or credentials are built in.
defaultPrompt: Ideal Client Persona, list the available approved buyer profiles for this client.
Ideal Client Persona, speak as the profile I name and react to this message as a real buyer.
Ideal Client Persona, switch to another approved profile in this client project.
